extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML sections, figures, Tables 3-4, and supplementary PDF text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper uses the established cationic amphipathic membrane-disruption rationale for short alpha-helical AMPs as background, but does not directly assay molecular membrane disruption in this study.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: halictine/HAL-2 analogues I-XII as discussed in the introduction and design rationale
mechanism_claims.limitations: Literature-supported mechanism context only; not promoted to direct_mechanism for this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP-loaded ChronOS calcium phosphate cement produced direct phenotypic eradication/reduction of viable microbes in the induced human spongy-bone infection model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: selected peptide analogues and mixtures in Table 3, especially peptide VI and I/II mixtures
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic efficacy endpoint; not a molecular target/mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AMP-loaded Palacos bone cement reduced microbial adhesion and biofilm-associated CFU on implant surfaces in the local bone model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: selected peptide analogues in Table 4 and Figure 4
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm prevention/adherence phenotype; figure bar heights were not digitized as exact numeric records.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Supplementary figures provide visual examples of peptide treatment and biofilm prevention contexts, including peptide I preventing Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilm formation on Palacos cement.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Supplement supplies visual/contextual confirmation, not additional structured numeric tables.
